page.overview:
Who is Bianca Bagetti?

Lady Bianca Bagetti was a member of the Janusian Faithful.

Roella Ramsby travelled to Arrakis alongside other nobles including Phaedra Vye, Mon Torsival, Marara Torbin, Priorin Tannat, Len Artuni, Agade Yimari, Ogdan Barbalescu, Menoria Tamar, Oona Byrn, Venesir Ask, Roella Ramsby, Eulalia Harthorn, Ansel Virro and Hesperia Farani. The group were very secretive, refusing to dine with House Atreides, attend the salons or allow anyone outside their group to dine with them.

Bagetti attended a banquet alongside Harthorn, Virro, Yimari, Ramsby and Byrn. The attendants all drank poisoned wine and their the masks were also poisoned and sealed to their faces, killing them. The scene was later investigated by Dhood Shazz and the Prisoner.
